text.en: No dual-axis Business Activity state (new demand/orders x production/utilization) is asserted: the owner-published engine.business_cycle artifact exposes only blended leading/coincident/lagging tier composites, not the individual orders/production/inventory legs the blueprinted headline needs. Rather than estimate a fabricated split, the real tier-level reads are published as metrics instead.
text.zh: 未给出双轴商业活动状态（新增需求/订单 × 生产/产能利用）：所有者发布的 engine.business_cycle 制品仅公开了混合的领先/同步/滞后层综合指数，而非蓝图所需的独立订单/生产/库存分项。为避免虚构拆分，改以指标形式发布真实的分层读数。

text.en: Leading tier: 6-month momentum 0.7084035025522297, direction rising, breadth 100.0 (share of legs rising over the diffusion window, 0-100).

text.en: Owner four-phase cycle clock reads 'recovery' from the sign of leading vs coincident 6-month momentum. This read is shared substrate with the future Growth & Real Economy workspace; it is disclosed here for context, not claimed as a business_activity-exclusive state.
text.zh: 所有者四阶段周期时钟读数为“recovery”，依据领先层与同步层6个月动量的符号得出。该读数与未来的“增长与实体经济”工作区共享同一底层数据，此处仅作背景披露，不作为商业活动专属状态。

text.en: Owner recession-risk signal (Conference-Board '3 D's' on the leading tier) reads 'off'. Calibrated leave-one-recession-out on a tiny (~3 endogenous) modern-recession sample -- a recession-RISK timeline, not a crash oracle.
text.zh: 所有者衰退风险信号（基于领先层的Conference-Board“三要素”规则）读数为“off”。已在极小样本（约3次内生衰退）上做留一法样本外校准——这是衰退风险时间线，并非崩盘预言。

text.en: The survey lane (ISM/regional-Fed manufacturing & services PMIs) is not shown: no lawful survey collector is wired in this repository (RIGHTS_BLOCKED). Only the hard-data lane (engine.business_cycle tier composites) is published; a preliminary/final print distinction is not invented in its absence.
text.zh: 调查分项（ISM/地区联储制造业与服务业PMI）未展示：本仓库未接入任何合法的调查数据采集器（权利受限，RIGHTS_BLOCKED）。仅发布硬数据分项（engine.business_cycle 分层综合指数），不会在缺失时臆造初值/终值的区分。

items.transformation: leading tier: standardized-leg cumulative composite, rebased to 100 at first valid month (Conference-Board method)
tier index level minus its value 6 months prior (CB '6-month change', red line)
EMA smoothing of the 6-month momentum series (blue line)
share of the tier's sign-adjusted legs that rose over the diffusion window (CB breadth, 0-100)
'rising' if 6-month momentum > 0 else 'falling'
owner-published live leg count out of 8 configured legs -- never refused by the coverage floor; the count itself is the ragged-edge honesty flag
coincident tier: standardized-leg cumulative composite, rebased to 100 at first valid month (Conference-Board method)
tier index level minus its value 6 months prior (CB '6-month change', red line)
EMA smoothing of the 6-month momentum series (blue line)
share of the tier's sign-adjusted legs that rose over the diffusion window (CB breadth, 0-100)
'rising' if 6-month momentum > 0 else 'falling'
owner-published live leg count out of 4 configured legs -- never refused by the coverage floor; the count itself is the ragged-edge honesty flag
lagging tier: standardized-leg cumulative composite, rebased to 100 at first valid month (Conference-Board method)
tier index level minus its value 6 months prior (CB '6-month change', red line)
EMA smoothing of the 6-month momentum series (blue line)
share of the tier's sign-adjusted legs that rose over the diffusion window (CB breadth, 0-100)
'rising' if 6-month momentum > 0 else 'falling'
owner-published live leg count out of 5 configured legs -- never refused by the coverage floor; the count itself is the ragged-edge honesty flag
6-month change in (coincident_index / lagging_index), rebased to 100 at first valid month; itself a classic leading read
Conference-Board '3 D's' (Depth+Duration AND Diffusion) rule on the leading tier, held N months
four-phase clock from the sign of leading/coincident 6-month momentum (expansion/slowdown/contraction/recovery)
out-of-sample (leave-one-recession-out) catch rate on ~3 endogenous modern recessions; tiny sample, see caveat

ISM/regional-Fed manufacturing & services PMIs are 50-line diffusion indexes (>50 expansion, <50 contraction), NOT a zero-line series; no lawful collector for this survey family is wired in this repository -- typed RIGHTS_BLOCKED, never estimated from hard data
